xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5103: Add Claude Fable 5.2 (claude-fable-5-2): catalog, pricing, capability, defaults, then release to NPM

plan.title: Add Claude Fable 5.2 (claude-fable-5-2): catalog, pricing, capability, defaults, then release to NPM
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Mechanical model addition across the catalog, cost, compaction and dashboard layers plus docs (about 30 files including tests). Splitting into sibling issues would force several releases for one model launch the operator wants shipped today in one PR, the same call PAN-4327 (Sonnet 5.5) made.

narratives.Problem: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 (claude-fable-5-2) on 2026-11-09: 1M context, 128K output, $8/$40 per million tokens, cheaper and faster than Fable 5.1. Overdeck does not know the ID, so it is missing from every picker, the cost tables price it as Fable 5 via the prefix fallback, the session parser folds it into Fable 5, and the PAN-4359 launch gate has no Claude Code minimum for it.
narratives.Proposal: Add claude-fable-5-2 everywhere claude-fable-5-1 is registered (diff template: commit 780357f9882, Haiku 5.5): the AnthropicModel union, an AUDITED_MODEL_ADDITIONS row placed first among Anthropic models (blend 24, 1M, 128K output, low..max effort, supportsSamplingParams false, minClaudeCodeVersion 2.1.321 verified by probing 2.1.293/2.1.319/2.1.321), capability class frontier, provider maps, an exact DEFAULT_PRICING row, a parser branch before the 5.1 check, a 1.2M-char compaction budget, Fable-family friendly names, and the three dashboard model lists. Keep Fable 5.1 selectable as the previous Fable. No default moves, because no code default names Fable 5.1; only two rationale comments change. Document the model and add an unreleased v0.75.0 changelog entry. The Flywheel releases v0.75.0 after merge.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Releasing to npm; the Flywheel runs pan release stable --version 0.75.0 after merge, green main CI and deploy
- Upgrading this host's Claude Code; that is a post-merge operator/Flywheel step through the PAN-4359 upgrade path, never npm install -g from the work agent
- Rebuilding sync-sources/hooks/record-cost-event.js (tracked in PAN-5104)
- Fast-mode pricing (speed: "fast", $16/$80) and the Foundry claude-fable-5-2-fast deployment ID
- Batch-API pricing
- Changing any default model, preset value, workhorse slot or role fallback, or adding a hardcoded model fallback
- Changing the operator's live ~/.overdeck/config.yaml
- Adding a Fable 5.1 compaction budget row
- Editing src/lib/__tests__/fixtures/pre-opencode-model-catalog.json
- Renaming Fable 5.1's displayName

autoDecisions.rationale: Probed 2026-11-09: 2.1.293 reports unrecognized_model and a 200K window; 2.1.319 still reports unrecognized_model and costBasis unknown; 2.1.320 was never published; 2.1.321 reports a 1M window, costBasis list and no warning. The issue's rule selects the oldest version without unrecognized_model and with a 1M window.

autoDecisions.summary: No default flips; only the presets.ts:168 comment and the model-presets.mdx:105 rationale change to name Fable 5.2.
autoDecisions.rationale: git grep shows no code default, preset value or role fallback whose value is claude-fable-5-1, frontier models are banned as defaults (TieredExecutionSection.tsx:44), and Fable 5.2 has no Overdeck eval while costing 2x Opus 5.5.

autoDecisions.summary: Do not rebuild the stale cost hook bundle in this PR; filed PAN-5104.
autoDecisions.rationale: A rebuild drags a 1 MB diff of every src/lib change since 2026-10-01 into a model-launch PR (see PAN-2699). The issue's cost acceptance is satisfied by src/lib/cost.ts and its tests, which the reconciler and dashboard read paths use.

autoDecisions.summary: The work agent does not upgrade the host's Claude Code.
autoDecisions.rationale: It is a host-wide side effect outside the workspace; tests do not need it and no configured model triggers the PAN-4359 refusal. The operator or Flywheel uses the dashboard Upgrade Claude Code button after merge.

autoDecisions.summary: Fable 5.2's capability row goes directly before claude-fable-5-1 in AUDITED_MODEL_ADDITIONS, with skill scores copied verbatim from Fable 5.1.
autoDecisions.rationale: Additions spread first, so this makes Fable 5.2 the first Anthropic row in the Settings catalog API as the issue requires; inheriting the previous family baseline until benchmarked is the existing convention.

autoDecisions.summary: Friendly names cover Fable 5.2, 5.1 and 5; the compaction budget adds only Fable 5.2.
autoDecisions.rationale: getFriendlyModelName has no Fable branch, and naming only 5.2 would leave its siblings as raw IDs (display-only change). A Fable 5.1 compaction row would change 5.1's existing behavior, which the issue does not ask for.

autoDecisions.summary: Changelog uses an Unreleased v0.75.0 block in the RELEASING.md format, without a PR link.
autoDecisions.rationale: The release step sets the date, adds the other merged entries and PR links; the work agent does not know its PR number when writing the entry.
